title: What a Danish full invoice and credit note state
source: Momsbekendtgørelsen § 58, stk. 1 (fuld faktura) and stk. 2 (a credit note that refers to the invoice), as Skattestyrelsens Juridiske Vejledning A.B.3.3.1.4 restates them; § 66 for the simplified invoice under 3.000 kr, cited. Read 2026-10-09.

rules.text: The seller's CVR-nummer, both parties' names and addresses, number, date, each line's unit price, the rate and the VAT on the page; a Danish bank transfer's registration and account number; the CVR under scheme 0184 in the UBL.
